name: modify_order_items
description: Change the line items on an order and adjust its stock reservations. mode selects the operation and decides which fields each entry in items carries: add takes sku and quantity, remove takes sku with an optional quantity, and replace takes sku together with replacement_sku.

mode.description: Which of add, remove or replace to apply to every entry in items.

items.description: Entries to apply. The fields each entry needs depend on mode.

sku.description: Variant identifier. In replace mode, the line being changed.

quantity.description: Units. Required for add, optional for remove, unused for replace.

replacement_sku.description: The variant to swap in. Used by replace mode.

error_returns.when: The order does not exist, or a named SKU is not on it.
mode is not add, remove or replace; items is empty; or a replace entry has no replacement_sku.
The order is not in a modifiable state.
An add or replace needs more units than exist.
